purpose: Teach: まなざし/哀しい/長続き/パラパラ/ふい/呆然と/生れ/ただ今

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの優しいまなざしを覚えていてね
lines.en: Sho, remember Grandpa's kind gaze, yes?
lines.style: Soft, almost singing the words. Maternal certainty wrapped in gentleness. Eyes that hold memory. Slight upward lilt at the end, inviting him into something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お別れの時、哀しい気持ちになるよ
lines.en: Mom, when we say goodbye… I get sad inside.
lines.style: Small voice, but steady. The admission costs him something. Looks down slightly. Searching for her understanding without demanding reassurance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達との関係を長続きさせるのは大事ね
lines.en: Sho, it matters to keep friendships alive, doesn't it.
lines.style: Quiet teacher-tone, but maternal. Not lecturing — offering him a frame for what he's feeling. Thoughtful pause before the period, like she's handing him something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、雪がパラパラ降ってきたの見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the snow falling earlier!
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaking through. Quick, eager delivery. The words tumble out — he's caught something beautiful and wants to share it right now, pulling her attention to the window of the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがふいに帰っていらしてびっくりしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad came home so suddenly — I was quite surprised!
lines.style: Light exclamation of delight. Quick tempo, a little flustered in the best way. The admission of surprise carries warmth — she's still pleased by him, by the interruption to routine, by his sudden return.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお写真の前で呆然と立っていたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was just standing there in front of Grandpa's photo… stunned.
lines.style: Soft, almost meditative. Long pause before 'stunned' — he's still there in that moment, not quite in the room with her. Quiet reverence. Words come slowly, like reaching back.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママが生れたのは雪の日だったのよ
lines.en: Sho, I was born on a snowy day, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself, then turning to him. Sharing a small secret across time. Tender and matter-of-fact at once. Like connecting two snowy moments into one.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ただ今戻りましたって、お父さんの真似したよ
lines.en: Mom, I just came home! — I copied what Dad does!
lines.style: Pride and mischief bright in his voice. He delivers the phrase like Dad — formal, slightly theatrical — then breaks into his own laughter. Pleased with himself. Seeking her laugh in return.
